title: The Vanishing Violin
scene: At 9:10 PM, the solo violin vanished backstage. The hall's fire doors were sealed for the encore from 9:00 to 9:20.

suspects.name: Mara Voss
suspects.testimony: I was tuning onstage with the orchestra from 9:02 to 9:18. The doors stayed shut behind us.
suspects.alibiProof: The conductor's score notes show Mara's tuning cue at 9:03 and her stand empty until 9:19.

suspects.name: Elias Fenn
suspects.testimony: I was stacking chairs in the side wing from 9:00 to 9:20. I never went near the green room.
suspects.alibiProof: The wing camera shows Elias folding chairs at 9:05, 9:12 and 9:18.

suspects.name: Juno Marsh
suspects.testimony: I was in the lobby at 9:10, selling programs while the doors were sealed.
suspects.contradiction: The lobby till had no sales after 9:02, and the sealed-door log lists Juno as the only bearer of a backstage key.

suspects.name: Tessa Lund
suspects.testimony: I was beside Mara onstage from 9:02 to 9:18. We shared the same stand.
suspects.alibiProof: Tessa's bow rosin and seat are visible in the 9:16 stage photo.
